Title: Aarav's Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Ananya - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Sharda - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Sonali: "I knew it!"

[Aarav runs to Mother.]

Sonali (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Aarav tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aarav: "What happened?"

[Aarav hides behind the tree.]

Aarav: "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Night

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Sonali: "Yes, all right."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Aarav: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Ananya: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Aarav: "Yes, of course."

[Aarav mops the floor.]

Aarav: "Let's see."

[Aarav irons his school shirt.]

Aarav: "Grandma, look at this."

Scene 4: The garden - Day

Aarav: "Mom, look over here."

[Aarav waters the plants.]

Aarav: "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Sonali (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
